protocol.design: dual-track evaluation on frozen pools; every ranker applied by the same cached code path

rankers.rerank: bge-reranker-v2-m3 over titles (S2 recipe, corrected ordering)
rankers.hybrid_rrf: RRF(k=60) of pool order and dense order --- the S3 fusion stage on its own; S3's trailing cross-encoder is measured by the ``rerank`` ranker
rankers.mdense: max bge-m3 cosine over the recorded six-language translations (S6 recipe)

protocol.set_recall_note: Within a track every method sees the same candidate set, so SetRecall is constant and only the ranking metrics differ; SetRecall differences across tracks are the federation effect.
